about.title: Our story
about.intro: Every piece we offer begins as a branch of an olive tree in and around Bethlehem.
about.p1: Olive trees here can live for hundreds of years. The wood our carvers use comes from branches trimmed when the trees are pruned.
about.p2: Each piece is cut, carved, sanded and finished by hand, so the grain, colour and size vary a little from one piece to the next.
about.p3: We are a small shop, and we would rather tell you plainly what you are buying than promise too much. If you have a question about a piece, write to us and we will answer honestly.
about.sister: Gethsemane is the sister store of <link>holylandtimber.com</link>.
about.emblemAlt: Gethsemane logo: an ancient olive tree and olive press inside an arch, topped by a cross
about.name: The name Gethsemane comes from Hebrew and Aramaic words commonly translated as “oil press”. It refers to the olive garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem, where, according to the Gospels, Jesus prayed on the night before his crucifixion. Our pieces are carved from olive wood, and the name keeps that link to the olive tree.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers to the questions we hear most. Something missing? Ask us.
faq.a1: They are handmade by carvers in Bethlehem. Each piece is cut, carved and finished by hand.
faq.q2: Will my piece look exactly like the photo?
faq.a2: Not exactly. Olive wood has a natural grain, so colour and pattern vary from piece to piece. That variation is part of the material, not a defect.
faq.q3: Where does the wood come from?
faq.a3: From branches trimmed when olive trees are pruned.
faq.q4: Can a piece be engraved or customised?
faq.a4: Some pieces can be engraved: choose the engraving option on the product page and type your text. Engraved and personalised pieces cannot be returned unless faulty.
faq.q5: Do you supply churches, ministries or shops?
faq.a5: Yes. Write to us through the contact page with the pieces and quantities you need, and we will reply with a quote.
faq.q6: How do I place an order?
faq.a6: Add pieces to your order, go to checkout, enter your email and delivery address, choose shipping and pay by card. We email your order confirmation once the payment is confirmed.
faq.q7: Where do orders ship from, and how long does delivery take?
faq.a7: {shipFrom} We prepare orders in {processingMin}–{processingMax} business days; delivery typically takes {deliveryMin}–{deliveryMax} business days after dispatch to most destinations, and remote areas can take longer. These are estimates, not guarantees.
faq.a8: Customs duties, import taxes and any handling fees are paid by the buyer. In some countries taxes are instead collected by the carrier or at the border. We describe the contents and value truthfully on customs forms.
faq.a9: Yes, within {days} days of delivery. We ask that the piece is unused and in its original packaging, and that you contact us first with your order reference. Engraved or personalised pieces (unless faulty) and pieces marked as final sale cannot be returned this way. These limits do not apply to your statutory right of withdrawal (EU/UK) or your legal guarantees; exceptions to withdrawal apply only to personalised or custom-made items.
faq.q10: What if my parcel arrives damaged?
faq.a10: Tell us within {days} days of delivery and send photos of the outer box and the item. We will replace it or refund you, and you will not need to send it back. This does not affect your legal rights.
faq.q12: Are the prices in my currency exact?
faq.a12: Prices are set in US dollars and you are charged in US dollars. Other currencies are approximate conversions; your bank may convert at its own rate and charge a fee.
faq.a11Card: You pay by card at checkout. The charge is in US dollars. Your card details are entered on our payment provider's page, never on this website. We start preparing your order once the payment is confirmed.
faq.a11Soon: Online payment is opening soon. Until then, write to us and we will help you with your order.
faq.q13: How can I follow my order?
faq.a13: Use the order tracking page with your order number and email address, or sign in to your account. We email you the carrier and tracking number when your order ships.

shipping.delivery: Delivery after dispatch: typically {min}–{max} business days to most destinations; remote areas can take longer.

shipping.cost: The shipping cost depends on the destination and the shipping method you choose. The checkout shows it before you pay.
shipping.customs: Customs duties, import VAT or sales taxes and any carrier handling fees are paid by the buyer. returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.intro: If a piece is not right for you, you can return it.
returns.period: If you change your mind, you can return a piece within {days} days of delivery. To make this simple for both of us, we ask that the piece is unused and in its original packaging, that you include your order reference, and that you contact us before sending it back.
returns.excluded1: Engraved or personalised pieces, except where faulty (we tell you before you order).
returns.excluded2: Pieces clearly marked as final sale before you order.
returns.variation: Natural variation in grain and colour is a quality of olive wood, not a defect, and does not affect your statutory rights.
returns.cost: Return shipping is paid by the customer unless we made a mistake or the piece is faulty. Please note that international return postage can cost more than the piece itself; we are happy to talk it through with you first.
returns.refundEu: Customers in the EU and the UK: we refund you to the original payment method within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal notice. We may wait until we have received the piece back, or proof that you have sent it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page describes what this website actually does with personal information.
privacy.browser: Your basket and wishlist are stored only in your own browser (local storage) until you check out.
privacy.use: We use your details only to run your account, fulfil your order and answer you. We do not sell or share personal data for marketing.
privacy.retentionYears: We keep order records for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}, then delete them.
privacy.retentionDefault: We keep order details only as long as needed to fulfil your order and meet legal obligations such as accounting.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you, and you can complain to your data protection authority. With an account, you can download or delete your data yourself; otherwise contact us through the <link>contact page</link>.
privacy.transfer: We are based in Bethlehem. When you order or write to us from another country, your information is transferred to us there; when we ship your order, it goes to the carriers that deliver your parcel. The website and some service providers are in the United States (see Service providers).
privacy.children: This site is not aimed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.
privacy.security: This site is served over HTTPS. Passwords are stored only as secure hashes, and card details never reach our servers.
privacy.changes: If what the site does changes (for example, if we add analytics), we will update this page first.
privacy.hosting: Hosting: the site is hosted by Vercel Inc. in the United States. Like any web host, Vercel processes technical data such as IP addresses to deliver pages and keep the site secure, so this data is transferred to the United States.
privacy.controller: The controller responsible for your personal data is:
privacy.cookies: The site sets only cookies that are strictly necessary: NEXT_LOCALE (your language) and currency (your currency), each kept for one year, and, when you sign in, a session cookie that keeps you signed in for up to 14 days. None of them is used for tracking.
privacy.basisContract: Performing your order and running your account: processing, shipping, support and returns.
privacy.basisInterest: Our legitimate interest in running the site and keeping it secure, for example by limiting repeated sign-in attempts. For this we keep a pseudonymised (hashed) form of your IP address, only briefly.
privacy.basisConsent: Your consent for anything optional, such as a gift note. You can withdraw it at any time.
privacy.tracking: The site uses no analytics, no advertising or tracking cookies, and loads no third-party scripts.
privacy.orders: We collect your email address, the delivery address, a phone number if you give one, the pieces you order and an optional gift note. We use them to process, ship and support your order and to email you about it: the order confirmation, shipping updates and replies to your questions.
privacy.accounts: If you create an account, we store your name, your email address, your password as a secure hash (never the password itself), your saved addresses and your orders. While you are signed in, a session record with your browser type keeps you signed in.
privacy.accountsControl: In <link>your account</link> you can download all of this as a file and delete your account at any time. Deleting it removes your profile, addresses and unpaid orders; paid orders are kept, without your phone number or gift note, only as long as accounting law requires.
privacy.messages: Messages sent with the contact form reach us by email, with your name, email address, optional order number and message. We use them only to reply.
privacy.payments: Payments: card payments are handled on our payment provider's page. Card details are never entered on or stored by this website.
privacy.paymentsStripe: Payments: payments are processed by Stripe. You enter your card details on Stripe's page; they are never entered on or stored by this website. Stripe also uses payment data to prevent fraud, under its own privacy policy.
privacy.emailProvider: Email: our emails (account, order and shipping emails, and contact form messages) are sent through Resend, which processes the email addresses and message contents on our behalf.
privacy.database: Database: account and order data is stored in a managed Postgres database operated for us by our database provider.
privacy.carriers: Delivery: to deliver your order we give your name, address and phone number to the shipping carrier.
privacy.basisLegal: Legal obligations, such as keeping accounting records of paid orders.
privacy.retentionOther: Sign-in sessions end after 14 days without a visit. Contact form messages are kept in our mailbox only as long as needed to answer you.

accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility
accessibilityPage.intro: We want everyone to be able to browse and order from this site.
accessibilityPage.target: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. Pages are tested with automated checks, with a keyboard only and at screen widths from 320 pixels up.
accessibilityPage.done: Text and controls meet AA contrast, every control can be reached with a keyboard and shows a visible focus ring, buttons are at least 44 pixels tall, motion is reduced when you ask your device for it, and changes to your order are announced to screen readers.
accessibilityPage.gap1: Product photos are still placeholders; descriptions of the real pieces will follow.
accessibilityPage.gap2: Payments are made on our payment provider's page, whose accessibility we do not control.
accessibilityPage.gap3: We have not yet tested the site with disabled users in person.
accessibilityPage.feedback: If something does not work for you, please tell us through the <link>contact page</link> and we will do our best to fix it.

care.title: Caring for olive wood
care.intro: Olive wood is dense and lasts a long time with very little care.
care.daily: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
care.oil: If the wood looks dry, rub in a few drops of food-safe mineral oil or a wood-bowl oil, leave it for a few minutes and wipe off the rest. Once or twice a year is usually enough. Avoid cooking oils such as olive oil, which can go rancid.
care.kitchen: Wash quickly by hand with a little mild soap and dry straight away.
care.avoid3: Radiators, heaters and long hours of strong sun.
care.variation: Small changes in colour over time are natural and part of the wood’s character.
